newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai baht up late, interbank rate steady.
newsitem.headline: Thai baht up late, interbank rate steady.

text.p: The Thai baht was slightly higher against the dollar in late trade on Friday, but market activities were very limited in the absence of offshore players, dealers said.
The baht firmed to 25.977/25.982 late from 25.980/25.990 earlier, dealers said.
"I have done nothing today. All local players already squared their positions, while there was no orders from Singapore and Hong Kong," said one dealer at a foreign bank.
Dealers expect the dollar demand to continue next week on high liquidity in the banking system.
The overnight interbank rate was unchanged at 7.00 percent, dealers said.
The one-month baht/dollar swap premium was quoted at 6.75/7.75 satangs per dollar late against 6.25/7.00 in early trade, dealers said.
